title: Z500 SE ABS
description: Representing Kawasaki's prowess in the Urban Roadster class, the Kawasaki Z500 SE ABS is delivers muscular mid-range acceleration paired with effortless city maneuvering. A 500cc powerplant pumps out 40 HP and 35 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Upright Neutral layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
